config.rationale: Refinement of the best prior config (res_cnn_base, 0.9875 val_acc). Key changes: (1) hidden 64→80 adds ~25% channel capacity without reaching the 96 that overfit at depth 6; (2) dropout 0.2→0.15 because all top configs converged by epoch 3, indicating the model is not overfitting and lighter regularization allows sharper features; (3) lr 0.001→0.0015 explores the log-scale neighborhood — the SGD/one_cycle variant at lr=0.01 achieved 0.9870, suggesting the adamw optimum may be slightly above 0.001; (4) label_smoothing 0.1→0.05 because the model already achieves 0.9875 balanced accuracy, and excessive smoothing may blunt the decision boundary on the 1.63× imbalanced classes; (5) adding 'contrast' augmentation directly targets the low channel variance (stds 0.12–0.18) by amplifying subtle inter-class differences in the G channel (highest std 0.177). Retains adamw+cosine+batch128+standardize+class_weighting as the proven backbone.
